cuisine_type: Milkshakes, Desserts, Coffee, Edible Cookie Dough
description: The Yard Milkshake Bar is a specialty dessert shop known for creative milkshakes as seen on Shark Tank. They offer signature milkshakes, edible cookie dough (made with heat-treated flour and no eggs), craft coffee blends, merchandise, and branded products.
